figurative_meaning_en: to keep a secret or confidential information hidden
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বিয়ের খবর পেটে রেখেছে।
এই বিষয়টা পেটে রাখো, কাউকে বলো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He kept the news of his marriage a secret.
Keep this matter to yourself; don't tell anyone.
note: This idiom metaphorically uses the stomach as a safe, hidden place, reflecting everyday Bengali expressions of discretion.
